short_title: ECP' 27 - 20th Edition, 7-10th September, Belgrade, Serbia
short_description: 20th European Congress of Psychology organized under EFPA on the theme 'Psychology: Responding to the Challenges of Technology and Humanity'.
sponsors_note: Organized under the auspices of EFPA; see official congress website for sponsors and partners.

short_title: APS' 27 - Annual Convention, 27-30th May, Seattle, USA
short_description: Annual international convention of the Association for Psychological Science covering empirical research across all psychological subdisciplines.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Association for Psychological Science (APS); financial assistance program available.

short_title: APA' 27 - Annual Convention, 12-14th August, San Francisco, USA
short_description: Annual convention of the American Psychological Association held in San Francisco and online, covering research, clinical practice, and policy.
sponsors_note: Organized by the American Psychological Association (APA); exhibitor and sponsor details listed on the official convention portal.

short_title: EABCT' 27 - 57th Congress, 8-11th September, Warsaw, Poland
short_description: 57th Annual Congress of the European Association for Behavioural and Cognitive Therapies on the theme 'CBT for Solidarity in Mental Health'.
sponsors_note: Hosted by the Polish Association for Cognitive and Behavioural Therapy (PTTPB) under EABCT.

short_title: EHPS' 27 - 41st Conference, 24-27th August, Bern, Switzerland
short_description: 41st Annual Conference of the European Health Psychology Society bringing together researchers and practitioners in health psychology.
sponsors_note: Organized by the European Health Psychology Society (EHPS) and local hosts in Bern.

short_title: EAWOP' 27 - 23rd Congress, 26-29th May, Lyon, France
short_description: 23rd European Congress of Work and Organizational Psychology on the theme 'Bridging people, organizations and technology'.
sponsors_note: Organized by the European Association of Work and Organizational Psychology (EAWOP); partners listed on the congress website.

short_title: HRI' 27 - 22nd Conference, 8-12th March, Santa Clara, USA
short_description: 22nd ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction featuring peer-reviewed research on human behavior, cognition, and social robots.
sponsors_note: Co-sponsored by ACM and IEEE; full sponsor list available on the official HRI 2027 portal.

short_title: SPR' 27 - 58th Annual Meeting, 30th June - 3rd July, Stockholm, Sweden
short_description: 58th International Annual Meeting of the Society for Psychotherapy Research on the theme 'Beyond Boundaries - Connecting Global Psychotherapy Research', with separate in-person and online tracks.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Society for Psychotherapy Research (SPR); hosted at Munchenbryggeriet in Stockholm.

short_title: ABCT' 27 - 61st Annual Convention, 18-21st November, New Orleans, USA
short_description: 61st Annual Convention of the Association for Behavioral and Cognitive Therapies focusing on empirical cognitive and behavioral science and clinical practice.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Association for Behavioral and Cognitive Therapies (ABCT); exhibitor and sponsor details posted on abct.org.

short_title: SEPI' 27 - 43rd Annual Conference, 20-22nd May, Newport, USA
short_description: 43rd Annual Conference of SEPI hosted at Salve Regina University on 'The Future of Psychotherapeutics: Knowledge Transfer, Technology, and the Self of the Psychotherapist'.
sponsors_note: Organized by SEPI at Salve Regina University; Paul L. Wachtel SEPI Travel Grant available for eligible attendees.

short_title: PS' 27 - Annual Meeting, 18-21st November, New Orleans, USA
short_description: Annual Meeting of the Psychonomic Society bringing together researchers in experimental and cognitive psychology at the Sheraton New Orleans.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Psychonomic Society; official program and partner details published on psychonomic.org.

short_title: ESCOP' 27 - 25th Conference, 30th August - 4th September, Cluj-Napoca, Romania
short_description: 25th Biennial Conference of the European Society for Cognitive Psychology hosted by Babes-Bolyai University. Symposia close Nov 30, 2026; talks and posters open Jan 15 to Mar 15, 2027.
sponsors_note: Organized by ESCoP and hosted by Babes-Bolyai University in Cluj-Napoca.

short_title: CogSci' 27 - Annual Meeting, 28-31st July, Bilbao, Spain
short_description: Annual Meeting of the Cognitive Science Society at the Euskalduna Conference Centre covering empirical, theoretical, and computational research on human and machine cognition.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Cognitive Science Society; student travel grants supported by the Robert J. Glushko and Pamela Samuelson Foundation.

short_title: SPSP' 27 - Annual Convention, 11-13th February, Philadelphia, USA
short_description: Annual Convention of the Society for Personality and Social Psychology gathering over 3,500 researchers at the Pennsylvania Convention Center.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Society for Personality and Social Psychology (SPSP); financial support programs available.

short_title: SRCD' 27 - Biennial Meeting, 8-10th April, Atlanta, USA
short_description: Biennial Meeting of the Society for Research in Child Development showcasing basic and applied developmental science and child policy research.
sponsors_note: Organized by the Society for Research in Child Development (SRCD); see official meeting website for sponsors.

short_title: ECDP' 27 - 23rd Conference, 24-27th August, Florence, Italy
short_description: 23rd European Conference on Developmental Psychology organized under EADP and hosted by the University of Florence.
sponsors_note: Organized by the European Association of Developmental Psychology (EADP) and hosted by Universita degli Studi di Firenze.

short_title: INS' 27 - Joint Conference with JSHBF, 22-24th June, Chiba, Japan
short_description: Joint Mid-Year Conference of the International Neuropsychological Society and the Japan Society for Higher Brain Function at Makuhari Messe.
sponsors_note: Co-organized by the International Neuropsychological Society (INS) and the Japan Society for Higher Brain Function.

short_title: FESN' 27 - 10th Scientific Meeting, 9-11th September, Warsaw, Poland
short_description: 10th Scientific Meeting of the Federation of the European Societies of Neuropsychology held at the University of Warsaw covering clinical and cognitive neuropsychology.
sponsors_note: Organized by FESN and local hosts at the University of Warsaw.

short_title: EPA' 27 - 35th European Congress of Psychiatry, 3-6th April, Florence, Italy
short_description: 35th European Congress of Psychiatry on the theme 'Innovating Mental Health: Towards Personalised and Integrated Care' at Fortezza da Basso.
sponsors_note: Organized by the European Psychiatric Association (EPA); listed fees are Country A rates excluding 22% VAT. Travel grants available.

short_title: WCP' 27 - 27th World Congress of Psychiatry, 4-7th November, Cartagena, Colombia
short_description: 27th World Congress of Psychiatry organized by the World Psychiatric Association bringing together global psychiatry and mental health researchers.
sponsors_note: Organized by the World Psychiatric Association (WPA); sponsors and CME details published on the official congress website.

short_title: IEA' 27 - Triennial Congress, 23-25th August, London, UK
short_description: Triennial Congress of the International Ergonomics Association hosted by CIEHF at ExCeL London covering human factors, cognitive ergonomics, and AI-human systems.
sponsors_note: Organized by IEA and hosted by the Chartered Institute of Ergonomics and Human Factors (CIEHF); student awards available.

short_title: IASR' 27 - 53rd Annual Meeting, 12-15th July, Dublin, Ireland
short_description: 53rd Annual Meeting of the International Academy of Sex Research covering interdisciplinary empirical research on human sexuality. Oral abstracts close Mar 5; posters Apr 2, 2027.
sponsors_note: Organized by IASR; student and travel awards supported in part by Springer Publishing Company.
